SubmitEvaluationTask.title: Submit an AI evaluation job
SubmitEvaluationTask.responseParamsDescription:
> The return result will be sent to the callback address provided by the caller via asynchronous callback. You must ensure that the provided callback address supports public network access. The data format of the callback request is as follows:</br>  
├─ OuterBizId: String (the external business ID passed when submitting the evaluation job)</br>  
├─ TaskId: String (evaluation job ID)</br>  
    └─ EvaluateResult: Object </br>  
        ├─ OverallScore: String (overall score: 0–5 points)</br>  
        ├─ ContentScore: String (content score: 0–5 points)</br>  
        ├─ ExpressionScore: String (expression score: 0–5 points)</br>  
        ├─ CommunicationScore: String (communication score: 0–5 points)</br>  
        ├─ Comment: String (feedback comment)</br>  
        └─ GrammarFeedback: String (grammar feedback)</br>
